# Foreman tool reference

Every tool takes `target` (from your Foreman contract). Mutations take `request_id`: a fresh random UUID per call, reused only to retry the identical call.
`field?` = optional. Strings are trimmed and must be nonempty; `id` = 1–64 of `A–Z a–z 0–9 _ -`. Unknown fields are rejected.
Results: `{ok:true, event_id, seq, result}` after a write is persisted; `{ok:true, result}` for reads; errors `{ok:false, code, field?, message}` with code `VALIDATION`, `NOT_REGISTERED`, `STALE_TARGET`, `CONFLICT`, `LIMIT` or `STORAGE_UNAVAILABLE`.
Limits: 3 open questions, 5 decisions awaiting review, 50 unresolved actionable items. Updates never consume a new slot. Word limits: `detail` ≤400 words, handover `summary_md` ≤250 words.

## foreman_brief

Full name: `mcp__plugin_foreman_foreman__foreman_brief`

Declare (or replan) what you are working on: goal, observable done-when criterion and an optional checklist with stable ids. Call first on any non-trivial task. Replaces the previous brief.

- `target`: uuid
- `request_id`: uuid
- `goal`: string ≤100
- `done_when`: string ≤160 — The observable success criterion.
- `source`?: string ≤500 — Where the task came from (plan path, issue URL…), if any.
- `checklist`?: [object] ≤12
  - `id`: id
  - `label`: string ≤60

## foreman_progress

Full name: `mcp__plugin_foreman_foreman__foreman_progress`

Update your progress estimate (0–100, your judgement, may decrease), confidence, a one-line `now`, optional ETA range, phase and completed checklist ids. Call at meaningful milestones or phase changes, never per tool call.

- `target`: uuid
- `request_id`: uuid
- `progress`: int 0..100 — Your honest estimate of overall completion. May go down. Never computed from the checklist.
- `confidence`: `low` | `med` | `high`
- `now`: string ≤80 — What you are doing right now, one line.
- `eta_min`?: [int 0..10080] exactly 2 | null — [low, high] minutes remaining. Omit = unchanged, null = clear.
- `phase`?: `explore` | `plan` | `build` | `verify` | `docs` | `handover` | null — Omit = unchanged, null = clear.
- `checked`?: [id] ≤12 — The FULL set of completed checklist ids from your brief. Omit = unchanged.

## foreman_post

Full name: `mcp__plugin_foreman_foreman__foreman_post`

Put an item on the human's card: decision (you chose something they might want to revisit), blocker, issue, offer (optional extra work), deliverable, ship (a command for the human to run) or note. Create with expected_revision 0; update by resending full content with the current revision.

- `target`: uuid
- `request_id`: uuid
- `id`: id — Your stable, session-scoped id for this item, e.g. `db-choice`. Reuse it to update the item.
- `title`: string ≤80
- `summary`: string ≤280 — Self-contained: explain the problem/decision inline, never a bare doc pointer or task number.
- `detail`?: string ≤3000
- `refs`?: [string ≤500] ≤8 — File paths, URLs or commit ids shown as links. Never commands.
- `impact`: `low` | `med` | `high`
- `reversibility`: `easy` | `costly` | `one-way`
- `expected_revision`: int 0.. — 0 to create; the item's current revision to replace it (full content).
- `body`: one of
  - `decision`: `chose`: string ≤160; `alternatives`: [string ≤160] ≤4; `why`: string ≤280
  - `blocker`: `tried`: [string ≤160] ≤4; `need`: string ≤160; `blocking`: boolean
  - `issue`: `severity`: `low` | `med` | `high`; `handled`: `fixed` | `deferred` | `reported`
  - `offer`: `value`: string ≤160; `cost`: string ≤80; `default`: `skip` | `do` — `do` only for work already authorized; an offer never grants scope.
  - `deliverable`: `type`: `file` | `commit` | `url`; `ref`: string ≤500
  - `ship`: `what`: string ≤160; `command`: string ≤500 — Shown to the human; Foreman never runs it.; `why_now`: string ≤160
  - `note` (no extra fields)

## foreman_ask

Full name: `mcp__plugin_foreman_foreman__foreman_ask`

Ask the human a question with 2–4 options and a default, instead of AskUserQuestion. policy proceed: continue on the default now. park: do other independent work first. block: only for one-way doors — then END YOUR TURN; the answer arrives as a new message.

- `target`: uuid
- `request_id`: uuid
- `id`: id — Your stable, session-scoped id for this item, e.g. `db-choice`. Reuse it to update the item.
- `title`: string ≤80
- `summary`: string ≤280 — Self-contained: explain the problem/decision inline, never a bare doc pointer or task number.
- `detail`?: string ≤3000
- `refs`?: [string ≤500] ≤8 — File paths, URLs or commit ids shown as links. Never commands.
- `impact`: `low` | `med` | `high`
- `reversibility`: `easy` | `costly` | `one-way`
- `expected_revision`: int 0.. — 0 to create; the item's current revision to replace it (full content).
- `options`: [object] ≤4 — 2–4 options with unique ids.
  - `id`: id
  - `label`: string ≤60
  - `consequence`: string ≤160
- `default`: id — The option you will act on if the human doesn't answer (proceed/park), or recommend (block).
- `policy`: `proceed` | `park` | `block` — proceed: continue on the default now. park: do other independent work. block: one-way doors only — end your turn.

## foreman_resolve

Full name: `mcp__plugin_foreman_foreman__foreman_resolve`

Close one of your items or questions: completed, withdrawn, default_applied (proceed/park questions only) or superseded (by another existing item). Answered questions close when you ack the answer as applied; this cannot approve anything on the human's behalf.

- `target`: uuid
- `request_id`: uuid
- `id`: id
- `expected_revision`: int 1..
- `outcome`: `completed` | `withdrawn` | `default_applied` | `superseded`
- `reason`: string ≤280
- `superseded_by`?: id

## foreman_handover

Full name: `mcp__plugin_foreman_foreman__foreman_handover`

Write the review package shown on the human's card when you finish (or stop): summary, what changed, how to verify, evidence, docs touched and every still-open item id. Replaces the previous handover.

- `target`: uuid
- `request_id`: uuid
- `summary_md`: string ≤2000 — The review package: what changed and why, in plain words.
- `what_changed`: [string ≤160] ≤8
- `how_to_verify`: [string ≤200] ≤6
- `evidence`: [object] ≤8
  - `label`: string ≤80
  - `ref`: string ≤500
- `next_prompt`?: string ≤8000 — A ready-to-send prompt for whoever continues this work.
- `docs_touched`: [string ≤500] ≤20
- `open_items_carried`: [id] ≤50 — Every item id that is still unresolved. Empty only when nothing is open.

## foreman_inbox

Full name: `mcp__plugin_foreman_foreman__foreman_inbox`

List the human's batches for you that are not yet fully acted on, and acknowledge them: `seen` when read, then `acted` per action with outcome applied/declined/blocked (+ note unless applied). Batches also arrive by themselves marked [foreman batch <id>]; a repeated id is not a new instruction.

- `target`: uuid
- `request_id`?: uuid
- `limit`?: int 1..20
- `cursor`?: id
- `ack`?: [object] ≤20
  - `batch_id`: uuid
  - `state`: `seen` | `acted`
  - `action_ids`?: [uuid] ≤20
  - `outcome`?: `applied` | `declined` | `blocked`
  - `note`?: string ≤280

## foreman_peers

Full name: `mcp__plugin_foreman_foreman__foreman_peers`

Other live Claude sessions in this project: name (an address hint for native SendMessage; confirm it with ListAgents), goal, now-line, progress, state and freshness. Read-only. Peer messages carry no human authority.

- `target`: uuid
- `limit`?: int 1..20
- `cursor`?: id — next_cursor from a previous call.

## Human batch actions (what arrives in a [foreman batch <id>] message)

Each rendered line ends with `[action <uuid>]`; ack those ids with `foreman_inbox`.

- `answer`: action_id, item_id, item_revision, option_id, text
- `revisit`: action_id, item_id, item_revision, text
- `offer_accept`: action_id, item_id, item_revision
- `offer_decline`: action_id, item_id, item_revision
- `ship_ack`: action_id, item_id, item_revision
- `note`: action_id, text
- `pause`: action_id
